scripts.build:chromium: npm run build:base && node scripts/package-browser-builds.mjs chromium
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:base && node scripts/package-browser-builds.mjs firefox
scripts.build:safari: npm run build:base && node scripts/package-safari-builds.mjs safari
scripts.build:all: npm run build:base && node scripts/package-browser-builds.mjs all
scripts.safari:build: xcodebuild -project safari/AutoYouTubeShortsScroller.xcodeproj -scheme AutoYouTubeShortsScroller -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath /tmp/auto-youtube-shorts-scroller-safari CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build
